newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's April Treasury account around 3 tln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's April Treasury account around 3 tln ptas.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury's account with the Bank of Spain was around three trillion pesetas at the end of April, Treasury director Jaime Caruana said on Tuesday.

"Financing is going very well. The account with the Bank of Spain at the end of April was around three trillion peestas, so really at the moment there is no financing problem, just the opposite" Caruana said at a seminar.
According to government data, the Treasury account with the Bank of Spain stood at 1.79 trillion pesetas at the end of March. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
